q: You are bandobast SI at Velagapudi Assembly gate during Budget session. A 300-strong dharna blocks all MLAs' entry and demands to enter the House. What is lawful duty?
options: Allow blockade as peaceful protest and stop all vehicles
Lathi-charge the crowd and arrest MLAs to avoid clash
Secure unobstructed entry for members and shift protest to designated zone
Lock the Assembly gate and suspend the sitting for the day
expl: House must function; protest regulated at earmarked site.
why: Legislature cannot be coerced by blocking access. Police duty is to enable sitting while balancing protest by time-place regulation.
trapnote: Trap: treats gherao of legislature as absolute free speech.

q: You are PSO at a Graduates' MLC booth in Guntur. A candidate's agent demands voters mark ballot openly before him to prevent cross-voting. What do you enforce?
options: Permit open marking to ensure party discipline
Enforce secret ballot; assistance only for disabled with RO permission
Hand over ballot box to agent for verification
Stop polling and order re-poll on oral complaint
expl: Council polls use secret ballot; no compulsion to disclose.
why: Secrecy is core to free elections. Agent cannot witness marking, and re-poll needs RO/Commission orders, not SI discretion.
trapnote: Trap: confuses Council indirect election with open show-of-hands.

q: During Lok Sabha election briefing, constables argue a Finance Bill stuck between Houses can be jointly voted. How do you brief to stop rumour?
options: Speaker's final decision on Money Bill stands; Lok Sabha prevails with safeguards
Rajya Sabha can amend and block Money Bill indefinitely
Governor decides the dispute at state level
Joint sitting is called by SHO for all bills
expl: Speaker certifies Money Bill finally; Rajya Sabha only recommends.
why: Constitution gives Lok Sabha primacy on Money Bills. SI must counter misinformation that could spark booth-level clashes.
trapnote: Trap: equates Money Bill with ordinary bill joint sitting.

q: Assembly dissolved and Governor's rule period briefing comes. Station writer asks from whom lawful executive orders will now flow. Your reply?
options: No government exists so SI acts on own discretion
Executive authority flows through Governor acting for President; routine chain continues
High Court takes over all executive work
Opposition leader becomes executive head
expl: On breakdown, state executive vests in President via Governor.
why: Dissolution does not create policing vacuum. Orders flow through Governor's administration until new House forms.
trapnote: Trap: assumes dissolution suspends police hierarchy.

q: A disqualified MLA, unseated by Speaker's order, tries to force entry into the House with supporters during sitting. Your bandobast action?
options: Allow entry since voters elected him
Use House marshals/Speaker direction; prevent unauthorised entry and regulate crowd outside
Arrest the Speaker for contempt
Hold a field trial and restore membership
expl: Speaker presides subject to judicial review; SI enforces order.
why: SI cannot override presiding officer's ruling. Duty is to prevent breach of privilege and keep peace outside.
trapnote: Trap: invites SI to decide disqualification merits.
